about_the_game:
Welcome to LEGEND BATTLES, AAA battle royale game of unprecedented ambition. Immerse yourself in a hyper-realistic 400 km² universe, a living, vibrant world populated by hundreds of futuristic megacities interconnected by vast road networks, where every detail, every corner, every horizon pushes the boundaries of realism.

 

Here, strikingly designed Metahuman avatars, dressed in millions of possible combinations, face off with tens of thousands of spectacular weapons and vehicles, in a ballet of fire, strategy, and survival. Every fight is an adrenaline rush, each game a new tale of bravery.

 

But LEGEND BATTLES isn't just about survival. Ultimately, it will mean living a second life, in a world where the action is as intense as the moments of freedom: futuristic car races, battles against legendary creatures, helicopter rides over megacities, city ​​tour by motorbike, or evenings suspended on the rooftops of an illuminated skyscraper with your friends.

 

We have designed a next-generation platform, a gigantic ecosystem built to last, to evolve, to inspire. LEGEND BATTLES is destined to become the global crossroads of diversity, peace, and friendship, a place where cultures meet, where gamers from around the world build a world in their own image.

 

And it all starts with Battle Royale. A raw, intense, and fair challenge. Because in such a vast territory of 20 km by 20 km, even the most seasoned players cannot hold back these numerous urban agglomerations with dense infrastructure, and newcomers are welcome. Each landing from your spaceship plunges you into the unknown. Like special forces in uncharted territory, you must explore, improvise, and survive.

 

We made this crazy dream a reality. Thanks to the latest technologies like Unreal Engine 5.6 and AWS GameLift, and thanks to a total commitment, both personal and financial. Because yes, we put everything into creating the game the world needed.

 

LEGEND BATTLES isn't just a game.

 

It's a world. A vision. A revolution.

 

LEGEND BATTLES isn't just a battlefield: it's a visual and strategic journey to the heart of hundreds of extraordinary megacities, designed to make you dream as much as it is to fight. Each location has been designed to amaze, surprise, and immerse. Here, you don't play in a setting: you live in a world.

 

Each of these megacities is a universe unto itself, with its own architecture, colors, and atmosphere. Each was built by a different team to ensure absolute diversity. No two locations are alike. And above all, no player can memorize the entire map, because we designed a vast world of 400 km², deliberately impossible to master.

 

LEGEND BATTLES rewards intelligence, responsiveness, strategy, and instinct, not mechanical repetition or the advantage of veterans over newcomers. Here, everyone has a chance. Because in the reality, no elite commando fights a hundred times in the same place. And we believe that a fair, inclusive, and unpredictable game is simply more fun.

 

We could try to list our battlefields, but their number is so great it would be futile. Imagine: futuristic megacities, cyberpunk megacities, Chinese megacities, space bases, interstellar hubs, Egyptian, Hindu, Incan, and alien temples, Arabian villages, extraterrestrial forests, eerie penitentiary centers, glittering casinos, lush cinemas, vast racetracks, immense hospitals, major international airports, smoky industrial sites, well-guarded military bases, hovering spaceships—and that's just to name a few. Every building, in every city, is fully accessible with varied interiors.

All feature sumptuous, well-furnished interiors, furnished rooftops, and sometimes even labyrinthine basements. Windows shatter under the impact, fences give way. No need to knock on the door: just drive your motorcycle through the bay window and enter the action.

 

The interiors are full of rich and surprising locations: corporate offices, universities, themed restaurants, pizzerias, fast food restaurants, cafes, pubs, luxury hotels, sci-fi libraries, cyberpunk bookstores, various businesses, shopping malls, fitness centers, spas, swimming pools, gyms, bowling alleys, nightclubs, cathedrals, shooting training centers, command centers, in a variety of styles ranging from modern realism to pure science fiction.

 

On the rooftops, life goes on. Zip lines, panoramic cafeterias, spas, green terraces, antennas, water tanks, giant air conditioners, billboards: everything is there to transform each rooftop into a tactical space or a place to relax until the bullets whistle.

 

Megacities are dense, vertical, complex, and multidimensional. They're full of hiding places, obstacles, and tactical cover: trees, bushes, signs, pylons, bus shelters, containers, vehicles, and scaffolding. And remember, in LEGEND BATTLES you can climb anywhere.

Danger can come from the ground, a balcony, a roof, a pylon, or a spaceship suspended in the sky. Let's talk about that.

 

These immense spaceships suspended in the air aren't just for decoration. They house active snipers who arrive by zip line, allow for high-altitude combat, and transform the sky into a war zone. They are so vast that it is possible to fight there as if in a flying base, provided you are not afraid of heights.

 

Battles in LEGEND BATTLES take place indoors, outdoors, on rooftops, in basements, and in orbit. Players can climb, leap, jump, and grapple—everywhere.

You no longer fight on a single plane. You evolve in a five-dimensional world—unpredictable, vibrant, vertical, and free.

In LEGEND BATTLES, flying isn't just a means of transportation. It's an experience. A thrill. A waking dream.

From your spaceship, you soar into the void, carried by your ultra-technological flight suit, equipped with jet packs and adorned with spectacular skins.

 

Below your feet, an ocean of futuristic megalopolises. Before you, total freedom.

You glide through the skies, master of your trajectory, but never of time: the descent is inevitable. Your suit doesn't rise; it gently guides you to the ground, forcing you to choose your landing spot with strategy and instinct.

 

When you touch down, it automatically detaches, ready to let you fight. Search the surroundings, collect your first weapons, a backpack, ammunition, your protective and medical equipment, and survival begins.

 

You can also land on the rooftops: because here, every rooftop is a battlefield in its own right, designed for combat, with walkways, shelters, and sniper platforms. If you're lucky, you'll find a sniper rifle and a long-range scope: position yourself, aim and make the city tremble.

 

No weapon? No problem. Dive into the void. Jumping from a 300-meter skyscraper, feeling the air rush past you at high speed, deploying your parachute at the last moment, in a festival of splendid colors and patterns, is a moment of pure adrenaline.

 

And if you're under fire, take a zip line for an emergency escape. But be careful: the enemy could be waiting for you at the finish line. Jumping mid-flight and landing elsewhere by parachute can sometimes save your life.

 

And then, sometimes, luck smiles on you. You find a helicopter. This is another dimension: flying as a team, shooting from the outside benches, laughing with teammates while soaring over the rooftops—the intensity is at its peak. But never forget: anything that flies can fall. An RPG, a burst from a Minigun, a well-aimed grenade launcher, and your helicopter becomes a flying torch.

 

What if it catches fire? Don't think. Jump. Save yourself. And live to fight again.

As soon as you hit the ground, every second counts. Chaos begins immediately. Shots ring out, enemies approach. Your survival instincts take over. Collect everything you can: weapons, ammunition, protection, medical kits. Sort later. Live first.

 

Equip yourself quickly: ballistic helmet, bulletproof vest, tactical backpack. Choose your two best rifles, a pistol, their attachments, their ammunition, grenades, combat knives, and even an electric guitar to defend your life in melee combat with style, along with all the medical supplies you need to heal and get back in shape. And above all, never neglect the white, red, green, yellow, and purple smoke grenades—they could be your only defense against a sniper in ambush.

 

When you spot an airdrop, dive in. Inside, perhaps the best equipment in the game. But beware: predators are watching you. Use the smoke. Take away. Run away. Stay alive. But that's just the beginning.

 

The game's real treasure is the energy capsules, precious and increasingly rare as the session progresses through its five phases. With each stage, the playing area shrinks, and beyond its circle, death is certain. You must fight to stay in the light, at the heart of the arena, until victory.

 

And as if that weren't enough, the planet itself is hostile. Due to its proximity to its sun, it is swept by devastating electromagnetic tornadoes. These energy colossi pulverize everything in their path. If you don't quickly understand their direction, you won't have time to escape their wrath.

 

In LEGEND BATTLES, danger is everywhere. Cities are veritable vertical labyrinths, each of whose thousands of buildings has several interiors with varied furnishings. Ambushes in stairwells, guerrilla warfare in offices, manhunts in underground parking lots, shootouts on rooftops, sniper attacks in desert mountains.

Every space is an opportunity or a trap. Your arsenal evolves with the combat: machine guns, shotguns, pistols, revolvers, fragmentation grenades, incendiary grenades, lethal gas grenades, stun grenades, decoy grenades, smoke grenades, and the range is complete with Molotov cocktails, remote-controlled C-4 explosives, and even fistfights for the final confrontations.

 

But what makes LEGEND BATTLES unique is its total freedom of movement. Climb everywhere: trees, lampposts, billboards, cranes, telecommunications towers, watchtowers, water towers, wind turbines, all infrastructure and buildings to access rooftops or interiors by breaking a window.

The world is fully climbable; each player can appear from anywhere and disappear just as quickly.

 

And then there are the zip lines. Present in all megacities, they transform a player into a human missile. In a fraction of a second, they descend upon you, ready to strike. These lightning attacks are unpredictable and devastating.

 

With LEGEND BATTLES, we broke the conventions of classic shooter games.

We created gigantic, fully accessible megacities, designed for total realism and merciless combat. This level of detail, this verticality, and this freedom are unprecedented in a video game.

 

All this was made possible by integrating the most advanced mapping technologies, next-generation game engines, and an uncompromising vision.

We've pushed all boundaries to bring you the ultimate urban combat.

 

LEGEND BATTLES – A new war. A complete world. A legend to be written.

In LEGEND BATTLES, the world isn't something you cross... it's something you conquer. And to do that, you'll need power, speed, and skill. We've designed an unprecedentedly rich fleet of vehicles, not just to get you around, but to offer you thrills, excitement, and endless tactical opportunities. From streamlined racing cars to shooter convertibles, from spacious sedans to miniature city cars, from sleek SUVs to rugged off-road 4x4s, from all-purpose vans to destructive pickups, from massive trucks to high-strung buggies, from racing motorcycles to city motorcycles, from custom motorcycles to motocross bikes, from military armored vehicles to combat helicopters, each vehicle is unique, each model expresses a playstyle.

 

Add to that racing cars that can reach 406 km/h, racing motorcycles that exceed 395 km/h, motocross bikes for climbing stairs, and even combat helicopters capable of carrying your squad into the heart of danger, and you have a mobile arsenal worthy of a world of war. But here, speed isn't everything; every vehicle is vulnerable; a collision, an ambush, a well-aimed shot, and your vehicle could burst into flames. Doors fly off, bumpers fall off, engines explode, tires burst, windows shatter, hood and trunk are torn off. Everything is destructible, everything can tip over.

 

Off-road vehicles and dirt bikes can go anywhere, and expect them to climb the stairs, break down the front door, and continue into the interior. You'll encounter a speeding vehicle whose passenger fires a heavy machine gun at you. Escape to survive by smashing a window with your fists to jump out.

 

You'll have to learn to drive carefully, to flee when necessary, to park under cover, and to anticipate, because in LEGEND BATTLES, fuel becomes a strategic resource too. Keep an eye on your fuel gauge. Drive too far without a jerrycan, and you'll end the game on foot, if you survive that long. And when you take to the skies, you'll understand what the word domination truly means. The agile, fast, and unpredictable 6-seater helicopters offer unparalleled mobile superiority. But be warned: a good pilot is a blessing.

One RPG shot, one burst from a Minigun, and you're in freefall.

 

In LEGEND BATTLES, piloting isn't an option; it's a path to survival, a weapon, a signature.

The four types of armored vehicles are a spectacular component of LEGEND BATTLES. Their design is well-crafted, their skins are varied and wonderful, and their detailed interiors offer impressive immersion. You truly feel like you're driving a real armored vehicle, as every element has been designed to match reality. But as in real life, an armored vehicle is never synonymous with invincibility. Many powerful weapons are capable of destroying them. On the other hand, firing from an armored vehicle, especially at high speeds, guarantees significant tactical superiority, as the occupants benefit from excellent protection. These vehicles are rare in the game and therefore extremely sought-after.

 

Helicopters, on the other hand, are formidable. When a pilot and gunner cooperate with precision, the damage inflicted can be devastating. Imagine a helicopter chasing a car at 130 km/h across a rocky desert, with a Minigun in action: it's difficult to escape such a threat unless the car's passengers are skilled enough to aim at sensitive areas of the aircraft, such as the turbine or fuel tank, because the helicopter's fuselage is unarmored. Passengers can therefore be injured, and if the pilot is shot down, the helicopter is doomed. It is then vital to jump before it explodes. The best seat on board? The outside gunner's seat, suspended from a side bench. During a tight turn, the effect is more intense than any roller coaster.

 

However, no helicopter can resist a sniper equipped with an RPG, especially if positioned on a nearby rooftop. The truth is, whether armored vehicles or helicopters, no means of transport can guarantee absolute safety. It is therefore essential for a team to have at least one player equipped with heavy weaponry, such as an RPG. This rocket launcher is capable of destroying most vehicles and causing massive damage, even inside buildings.

 

The grenade launcher is no exception. Less powerful than the RPG, it can still fire up to six grenades consecutively, providing extremely effective firepower. Speed ​​then becomes an ally: the faster a vehicle goes, the harder it is to hit. Above 200 km/h, the enemy's accuracy decreases drastically. But in enclosed environments, the grenade launcher becomes a formidable weapon, especially when coupled with a deadly gas grenade. Combining several types of weapons with complementary effects can turn a battle around. A wide variety of weapons enhances the game's strategic depth and allows each player to find their own specialty.

 

The Minigun is undoubtedly the most sought-after weapon. To capture it, an effective method is to eliminate the player using it. They leave behind the weapon and its ammunition. The Minigun is a six-barreled 7.62mm rotary machine gun, capable of firing between 2,000 and 6,000 rounds per minute, delivering devastating firepower. Fences, windows, vehicles: nothing can resist it for long. The ideal duo? An expert pilot and a Minigun shooter. A helicopter equipped with this weapon is a force of mass destruction. To escape, the best option is often to take refuge in a building or aim directly at the aircraft's rear turbine. Even the most powerful are not untouchable.

 

In a slightly lower but equally formidable range, the heavy machine gun fires up to 1,000 rounds per minute, while offering the possibility of precise single shots when equipped with a scope. It's a versatile weapon, highly prized by snipers who appreciate its ability to alternate between cover fire and surgical precision.

 

Finally, the flamethrower deserves special mention. Its impact is both physical and psychological. With a range of 8 to 30 meters, it generates a veritable wall of fire, disorganizing opponents, disrupting their reflexes, and creating an atmosphere of chaos. The blinding light of the fire makes it difficult for the shooter to aim. It's an impressive weapon, which is recommended to be used with equivalent firepower. To face the flamethrower, you must fight on equal terms.

In LEGEND BATTLES, every moment could be your last. Life hangs by a thread, and every fight leaves scars. But here, we heal, we support, we save. Because even on the battlefield, we rise again.

 

To deal with injuries, essential medical equipment is scattered throughout the terrain. When you find it, never let it pass you by. It can be canned food, energy drinks, painkillers, bandages, intramuscular syringes, or even cardiovascular injectors, sometimes lifesaving. Using it is quick, intuitive, and essential. Like refueling your vehicle, except this time, it's your life on the line.

 

But if you're lucky enough to play as a team, then your strength is multiplied tenfold.

 

Because here, team spirit is your best defense.

 

Your teammates are not just partners. They are your ramparts, your human shields, your hope in case of a fall. When a player collapses, seriously injured, time slows down. In a few seconds, a comrade throws smoke grenades to hide you from lurking snipers. He rushes to your side, kneels, and begins a risky cardiopulmonary resuscitation. Ten seconds. Ten seconds of total immobility. During this brief moment of eternity, he becomes an easy target. And yet, he stays for you.

 

Once you regain consciousness, you inject a cardiovascular shot, swallow an energy drink, and leave. Because your allies will soon need you too.

 

Team spirit is also the art of covering and advancing.

While your teammates run to take up position, you stay behind, saturating the enemy line, forcing the enemy to retreat. Then, when it's your turn, they take over. This precise coordination is what separates survivors from legends. Smoke grenades become your smoke screens, your invisible walls, your chances of survival. Here, strategy, speed, solidarity: it's the only path to victory.

 

But even with all this, sometimes a teammate falls for good. Yet even death isn't the end. As soon as they leave their resurrection chip behind, anything is still possible. Seize it. Go for it.

 

Find a resurrection station. Huge, exposed, and most likely guarded by the enemy. Remain cautious. Once inside, insert his chip. The machine triggers, travels back in time, and brings your ally from the past back to the present.

But don't just stand there. Run away. Dodge the gunfire. Buy time. Moments later, a flying taxi crosses the skies. On board, your newly resurrected comrade jumps into the air, deploys his parachute, and returns to the front lines, but he arrives unarmed, vulnerable, and exposed.

So, go meet him, cover his landing, and protect his return.

 

In LEGEND BATTLES, you never abandon your loved ones.

Optional in-game purchases available.

Imagine a helicopter chasing a car at 130 km/h across a rocky desert, with a Minigun in action: it's difficult to escape such a threat unless the car's passengers are skilled enough to aim at sensitive areas of the aircraft, such as the turbine or fuel tank, because the helicopter's fuselage is unarmored. Passengers can therefore be injured, and if the pilot is shot down, the helicopter is doomed. It is then vital to jump before it explodes. The best seat on board? The outside gunner's seat, suspended from a side bench. During a tight turn, the effect is more intense than any roller coaster.

 

However, no helicopter can resist a sniper equipped with an RPG, especially if positioned on a nearby rooftop. The truth is, whether armored vehicles or helicopters, no means of transport can guarantee absolute safety. It is therefore essential for a team to have at least one player equipped with heavy weaponry, such as an RPG. This rocket launcher is capable of destroying most vehicles and causing massive damage, even inside buildings.

 

The grenade launcher is no exception. Less powerful than the RPG, it can still fire up to six grenades consecutively, providing extremely effective firepower. Speed ​​then becomes an ally: the faster a vehicle goes, the harder it is to hit. Above 200 km/h, the enemy's accuracy decreases drastically. But in enclosed environments, the grenade launcher becomes a formidable weapon, especially when coupled with a deadly gas grenade. Combining several types of weapons with complementary effects can turn a battle around. A wide variety of weapons enhances the game's strategic depth and allows each player to find their own specialty.

 

The Minigun is undoubtedly the most sought-after weapon. To capture it, an effective method is to eliminate the player using it. They leave behind the weapon and its ammunition. The Minigun is a six-barreled 7.62mm rotary machine gun, capable of firing between 2,000 and 6,000 rounds per minute, delivering devastating firepower. Fences, windows, vehicles: nothing can resist it for long. The ideal duo? An expert pilot and a Minigun shooter. A helicopter equipped with this weapon is a force of mass destruction. To escape, the best option is often to take refuge in a building or aim directly at the aircraft's rear turbine. Even the most powerful are not untouchable.

 

In a slightly lower but equally formidable range, the heavy machine gun fires up to 1,000 rounds per minute, while offering the possibility of precise single shots when equipped with a scope. It's a versatile weapon, highly prized by snipers who appreciate its ability to alternate between cover fire and surgical precision.

 

Finally, the flamethrower deserves special mention. Its impact is both physical and psychological. With a range of 8 to 30 meters, it generates a veritable wall of fire, disorganizing opponents, disrupting their reflexes, and creating an atmosphere of chaos. The blinding light of the fire makes it difficult for the shooter to aim. It's an impressive weapon, which is recommended to be used with equivalent firepower. To face the flamethrower, you must fight on equal terms.

In LEGEND BATTLES, every moment could be your last. Life hangs by a thread, and every fight leaves scars. But here, we heal, we support, we save. Because even on the battlefield, we rise again.

 

To deal with injuries, essential medical equipment is scattered throughout the terrain. When you find it, never let it pass you by. It can be canned food, energy drinks, painkillers, bandages, intramuscular syringes, or even cardiovascular injectors, sometimes lifesaving. Using it is quick, intuitive, and essential. Like refueling your vehicle, except this time, it's your life on the line.

 

But if you're lucky enough to play as a team, then your strength is multiplied tenfold.

 

Because here, team spirit is your best defense.

 

Your teammates are not just partners. They are your ramparts, your human shields, your hope in case of a fall. When a player collapses, seriously injured, time slows down. In a few seconds, a comrade throws smoke grenades to hide you from lurking snipers. He rushes to your side, kneels, and begins a risky cardiopulmonary resuscitation. Ten seconds. Ten seconds of total immobility. During this brief moment of eternity, he becomes an easy target. And yet, he stays for you.

 

Once you regain consciousness, you inject a cardiovascular shot, swallow an energy drink, and leave. Because your allies will soon need you too.

 

Team spirit is also the art of covering and advancing.

While your teammates run to take up position, you stay behind, saturating the enemy line, forcing the enemy to retreat. Then, when it's your turn, they take over. This precise coordination is what separates survivors from legends. Smoke grenades become your smoke screens, your invisible walls, your chances of survival. Here, strategy, speed, solidarity: it's the only path to victory.

 

But even with all this, sometimes a teammate falls for good. Yet even death isn't the end. As soon as they leave their resurrection chip behind, anything is still possible. Seize it. Go for it.

 

Find a resurrection station. Huge, exposed, and most likely guarded by the enemy. Remain cautious. Once inside, insert his chip. The machine triggers, travels back in time, and brings your ally from the past back to the present.

But don't just stand there. Run away. Dodge the gunfire. Buy time. Moments later, a flying taxi crosses the skies. On board, your newly resurrected comrade jumps into the air, deploys his parachute, and returns to the front lines, but he arrives unarmed, vulnerable, and exposed.

So, go meet him, cover his landing, and protect his return.

 

In LEGEND BATTLES, you never abandon your loved ones.

Optional in-game purchases available.
